subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: Should one-way A2A handoff be added as an explicit `sessions_send` mode, as a separate one-way primitive, or deferred while only fixing narrower reverse-call and duplicate-delivery bugs?
rationale: Source inspection shows the requested behavior is missing, but the fix changes model-facing session semantics and compatibility for existing A2A workflows, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape.

options.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
options.body: Extend `sessions_send` with a clearly named one-way mode that keeps current conversation behavior as the default and adds docs/tests for both modes.

options.title: Create separate primitive
options.body: Add a `sessions_deliver` or `sessions_enqueue` style tool so dispatch cannot be confused with conversational `sessions_send`, accepting the cost of another model-facing tool.

options.title: Defer dispatch semantics
options.body: Keep only the current conversation lifecycle for now and handle narrower duplicate-delivery bugs such as the open reverse-call and mirror-dedupe PRs separately.

recommendation.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
recommendation.body: Extend `sessions_send` with a clearly named one-way mode that keeps current conversation behavior as the default and adds docs/tests for both modes.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal for session docs and A2A lifecycle decisions points to steipete-authored work in the central files.
